"""Main owns exact unmodified Xe host tests, serialized with all builds and GPU work."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/bench-xestrata-b9f00e9-pristine-20261013')
T = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.tools/intel-llvm-v711/install')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
s = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('xe_b9_host_test_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s)
s.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH=str(T / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8',
           LC_ALL='C.UTF-8', LD_LIBRARY_PATH=str(T / 'lib') + ':/opt/intel/oneapi/mkl/2026.1/lib',
           ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR='level_zero:cpu')
TESTS = ['model_spec_test', 'split_rules_test', 'batch_groups_test', 'draft_kv_plan_test',
         'iq_avx2_parity', 'expert_multi_test', 'q8k_quant_parity', 'q2_bitplane_parity', 'pool_tasks_test']
with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-current-xe-b9-host-tests-root-v1'
    m.require(not out.exists(), 'fresh host qualification')
    out.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[], evidence={},
             controller_sha256=m.sha(__file__), started_utc=m.utc(), main_reviewed=True,
             gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, tests=TESTS, build_proofs={})
    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    def run(label, argv, wall):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, W, wall=wall, cpu=wall * 8,
                             rss_cap=48 << 30, text_cap=32 << 20, total_cap=64 << 20,
                             file_cap=512 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        m.require(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label)
    try:
        for mode in ['free', 'contrib-llvm']:
            proof = B / ('main-current-xe-b9-xe-' + mode + '-build-root-v1/record.json')
            v = json.loads(proof.read_text())
            m.require(v['passed'] and v['complete'] and not v['active'], 'completed ' + mode + ' build')
            m.require(m.sha(v['binary']['path']) == v['binary']['sha256'], 'unchanged model binary')
            m.require(all(m.sha(W / p) == h for p, h in v['source_pins'].items()), 'unchanged complete source')
            r['build_proofs'][mode] = dict(path=str(proof), sha256=m.sha(proof))
            build = W / 'build' / mode
            run(mode + '-compile-host-fixtures', ['/usr/bin/nice', '-n', '10', '/usr/bin/cmake',
                '--build', str(build), '--parallel', '4', '--target', *TESTS], 900)
            run(mode + '-ctest-host', ['/usr/bin/ctest', '--test-dir', str(build), '--output-on-failure',
                '--timeout', '180', '-j', '1', '-R', '^(' + '|'.join(TESTS) + ')$'], 1200)
            m.require(m.sha(v['binary']['path']) == v['binary']['sha256'], 'fixture builds retain model binary')
        r.update(complete=True, passed=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, complete=owner.active is None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ['passed','error','tests']}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
